title: Tariff Cap Table: Vehicle Fee Cap on Cleaning and Damage Fees Cleaning Charges
content:
**Rule.** The vehicle fee cap of a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee approved at review is a multiple of the flat fee of the level held, and the multiple is read from the reported trip's ride option: a three-row option (Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV) takes the three-row cap multiple; a premium two-row option (Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black) takes the premium cap multiple; any other ride option takes the standard cap multiple.

| Ride option on the trip record | Cap multiple |
|---|---|
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV | 3.8 (three-row) |
| Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black | 3.0 (premium) |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard or Wayfare Green | 2.5 (standard) |

The ride option is read from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares). The vehicle fee cap is the ceiling the fee charged on approval is held to: where the fee would be above the cap, the cap is used in its place.

## Caps by level

| Cleaning level held | Flat fee of the level | Cap at 2.5 | Cap at 3.0 | Cap at 3.8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | $25.00 | $62.50 | $75.00 | $95.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 | $150.00 | $180.00 | $228.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 | $250.00 | $300.00 | $380.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | $150.00 | $375.00 | $450.00 | $570.00 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** At Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major), take a fee that would come to $510.00 before its ceiling. On a Wayfare XL trip the cap is $570.00 and $510.00 stands; on a Wayfare Black trip the cap is $450.00 and $450.00 is used; on a Wayfare Standard trip the cap is $375.00.
